title: Green Farming Tools for Sustainable Agriculture
reason: This video describes various eco-friendly farming solutions that help reduce environmental impact and increase productivity.

tasks.task: Explore sustainable farming equipment that uses solar energy for power.

subtasks.text: Explain how solar-powered water pumps are used to irrigate fields without relying on fossil fuels.
Describe how electric tractors powered by solar panels can perform heavy-duty tasks with zero emissions.

tasks.task: Highlight the benefits of drip irrigation systems for water conservation.

subtasks.text: Explain how drip irrigation systems reduce water usage by up to 60% compared to traditional sprinkler systems.
Describe how automated drip irrigation systems can adjust watering schedules based on soil moisture levels.

tasks.task: Discuss the use of organic fertilizers for soil health improvement.

subtasks.text: Explain how organic fertilizers like compost and manure provide essential nutrients to the soil.
Describe how using organic fertilizers can improve soil structure and retain water.

tasks.task: Describe how precision farming technology utilizes GPS and sensors for resource management.

subtasks.text: Explain how GPS-guided tractors can plant seeds and apply fertilizers precisely.
Describe how drones can monitor crop health and water levels with sensors for data-driven resource management.
